ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_ONE: I'm Kevin, an aspiring Fullstack Developer with a strong interest in web development, backend technologies and IT infrastructure.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_TWO: I enjoy turning ideas into working applications, understanding how things work under the hood and solving problems along the way. From HTML, CSS and TypeScript to Angular, servers and self-hosted systems, I like exploring the full picture of modern IT.
ABOUT.PARAGRAPH_THREE: I'm constantly learning, experimenting and building — with the goal of becoming a developer who doesn't just write code, but understands the systems behind it.
